evals.name: wellness-score-postmortem
evals.prompt: We shipped a 'wellness score' in our HR platform 6 months ago — it aggregates calendar density, Slack response times, and badge-in data to give employees a daily rating visible to them and their manager. Usage is high but anxiety is up. Run an ethicography — trace where we prioritized engagement over wellbeing and what we should have done differently.
evals.expected_output: Post-hoc ethical analysis tracing design decisions chronologically, identifying value trade-off moments, red flags that were ignored, and alternative paths with specific lessons learned.

evals.name: social-media-growth-hacks
evals.prompt: Our social app grew from 1M to 50M users using: imported contacts without clear consent, dark-pattern onboarding, and engagement-optimized notifications. Now we're a 'responsible' company. Run an ethicography on our growth phase — what did we do, why did we think it was OK at the time, and what should we acknowledge?
evals.expected_output: Honest ethicography tracing growth decisions, the rationalizations used at each stage, the harms caused, and a framework for genuine accountability rather than reputation management.

evals.name: accessibility-debt
evals.prompt: Our product has been live for 4 years. We've never done an accessibility audit. A blind user just publicly documented their inability to use our app. Run an ethicography — trace through our design process to understand how accessibility was deprioritized at every stage.
evals.expected_output: Ethicography identifying systemic deprioritization of accessibility, the implicit values revealed, organizational incentive structures that enabled it, and a path forward.
